vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: k-cinema-bridge
Version: 0.1.0

The skill bundle provides instructions for an AI agent to access and process public movie data from a JSON API hosted on GitHub Pages. The `SKILL.md` file clearly defines the API endpoints and data structures, and offers usage guidelines for the agent. There is no executable code, no evidence of prompt injection attempts to manipulate the agent into performing unauthorized actions, and no indications of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or obfuscation. All described actions are read-only GET requests to a specified, public API.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a publicly hosted JSON API (GitHub Pages) and its declared requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md describes a read-only JSON API (box office and upcoming movie data) and the skill requests no binaries, env vars, or installs — this matches the stated runtime behaviour (fetching public endpoints and filtering data). The repository lacks a top-level description but the SKILL.md is explicit about purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions only direct the agent to perform unauthenticated GET requests against the provided BASE_URL and to filter/parse the returned JSON; they do not ask the agent to read local files, access unrelated environment variables, or transmit data to third-party endpoints. The doc correctly warns that 'info' may be null and recommends null checks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification or code files are present (instruction-only), so nothing will be written to disk. Network fetches are limited to the declared BASE_URL (a GitHub Pages URL).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths — appropriate for a public, read-only API integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default agent invocation settings (user-invocable, model invocation allowed) are appropriate for this skill; it does not request persistent system-level privileges or alter other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill simply fetches public JSON files from a GitHub Pages URL and filters them — no credentials or installs are required. Before installing, verify the BASE_URL (https://uyeong.github.io/k-cinema-bridge) is a source you trust (a compromised or spoofed GitHub Pages site could serve incorrect data). Also follow the SKILL.md advice: handle null info fields, and consider caching responses if you want fewer network requests. Otherwise the skill's scope and requirements are proportionate to its stated function.
